mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as observed across multiple monetary policy cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.0% signals labor market tightness that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in housing starts (HOUST > 0.5%) and retail sales (RSAFS > 0.5%) indicates robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS MoM exceed 0.5%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions (GDPC1 QoQ > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and late-cycle condition holds, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction that typically precedes reduced corporate earnings, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) and year-over-year CPI inflation above 2.5% signal aggressive monetary tightening that elevates equity discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 150,000 jobs (PAYEMS > 150000) supports sustained consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150000, or Rank IC over 5-year rolling windows remains below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales declining below 480,000 million dollars (RSAFS < 480000) indicates weakening consumer spending that typically reduces corporate revenue growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS < 480000, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows falls below 0.02.
